CVF.dataStatement: 61 bands 400–1000nm/10nm; reject400–590nm, 41 usable bands600–1000nm. 120 views/3degree per plant, about2GB. Number/species of plants and exact payloads not given.
CVF.preprocessing: Remove poor bands, Gaussian smoothing; mutual information registration to790nm by 2D similarity transform (rotation/isotropic scale/translation), then linear regression across band transforms; white-reference normalization stated. Canny edges provide more candidate SIFT points.
CVF.segmentation: Kmeans4 classes with random initialization until convergence; SVM trained on one manually labeled hyperspectral image, RBF/default LIBSVM, apply to others. No numerical segmentation accuracy/independent test split.
CVF.results: Partial/disconnected 3D models600/800/850/900nm; 700/750nm not reconstructed. Models admitted inaccurate; merging and RGB comparison are future work, not implemented/validated here.
